workstreams.name: Global shell: responsive nav + search + account block
workstreams.goal: Make NavBar/SearchBar/SocialBar fit at 320-1023px with no horizontal overflow, while keeping the current desktop layout pixel-equivalent at >=1024px.
acceptance: At 320/360/390/414/768px on /en, /en/all-ads, /en/category/cars-and-vehicles, /en/search, /en/login, /en/chats, and one listing-detail route: no element right-edge exceeds innerWidth + 1

Mobile sheet trigger is reachable and opens at 320px; search input is focusable and submits inside the sheet; logged-out Login/Register/Sell links or, logged in, every SocialBar menu item are tappable
At lg: (1024px) and above, the nav renders the original desktop row with no visible change versus a pre-change screenshot
SearchBar's scope button and label never truncate to an unreadable sliver at 320px
Notifications, Messages, and avatar-trigger hit areas measure >=44x44 CSS px
verification: optional: chrome-devtools-axi open <url> for a manual look (CLI bridge may be unavailable; do not hard-depend on it)

workstreams.name: Card & category grid responsiveness
workstreams.goal: Replace every fixed/unresponsive grid-column or min-width rule that forces horizontal overflow below 640px, using the breakpoint ladder CategoryGrid.tsx already proves out.
acceptance: Re-measure only after W1 lands: at 320/360/390/768px on /en/all-ads, /en/category/cars-and-vehicles, /en/search, no AllAdsCategories/SubcategoryGrid/GridCardPost element's right edge exceeds innerWidth + 1
At 320px, category/subcategory circle grid renders 3 columns without clipping or overlap; card grid renders 2 columns without forcing the page wider than 320px
At >=1024px both grids render identically to today (md: breakpoint values unchanged; sm:min-w-[260px] still applies at and above 640px exactly as the old unconditional min-w-[260px] did)
GridCardPost's heart button measures >=44x44 CSS px
verification: git grep -n "gridTemplateColumns" apps/web/components/category-layouts/SubcategoryGrid.tsx (expect no matches after the fix)
git grep -n "min-w-\[260px\]" apps/web/components/ads/GridCardPost.tsx (expect sm:min-w-[260px], not a bare min-w-[260px])
node tasks/mobile-verify.mjs --base <fresh-build-url, same build as W1> --widths 320,360,390,768 --routes /en/all-ads,/en/category/cars-and-vehicles,/en/search

workstreams.name: Touch-target sizing: list cards & post-form delete button
workstreams.goal: Bring the two remaining sub-44px primary touch targets (outside the global shell and outside GridCardPost) up to 44px.
acceptance: ListCardPost's heart button and ListingPostForm's phone-row delete button both measure >=44x44 CSS px
List-view card layout does not visually shift or overlap the price/text beside the heart button after the hit-area grows, at 320/390 and at >=1024px
Post form's repeatable phone-number rows still align correctly with the larger delete button at 2 and 3 rows
verification: node tasks/mobile-verify.mjs ... (both buttons' small/sub-44px entries should disappear from output)
manual: toggle to list view and confirm the heart still toggles like state correctly

workstreams.name: Post-form category picker: touch-reachable subcategory switch
workstreams.goal: Make the mock DynamicForm's category picker operable by tap, not just mouse hover -- the load-bearing fallback for admin-created subcategories with no seeded field_schema.
acceptance: Tapping or clicking without hovering first on any top-level category button updates the right-hand subcategory pane to that category's subcategories
Existing hover-preview behavior for mouse users is unchanged
verification: git grep -n "onClick\|onMouseEnter" apps/web/components/post/PostForm.tsx (expect both handlers on the same button)

no seeded route currently exercises this branch; manual verification requires a throwaway admin-created subcategory with no field_schema, or a code-review walkthrough -- note this caveat rather than claiming an end-to-end click-test the current catalogue can't trigger

workstreams.name: Verification & re-measurement
workstreams.goal: Re-run the Lead's measured sweep against a build including W1-W4's changes, confirm the baseline overflow table is clean, and update the audit doc.
acceptance: Regenerated JSON's overflow array is empty and small array no longer contains the specific buttons fixed in W1/W2/W3
Manual 1280px screenshot comparison shows the desktop shell unchanged from a pre-change baseline (captured before W1 lands)
verification: acceptance criteria above are themselves the verification steps -- this is the final gate

IMPORTANT: do not measure against :3011 as-is (it is a pre-fix build and must not be restarted/killed); build+start a second preview on a free port or coordinate a redeploy of :3011 once W1-W4 are merged
